title: D3D12: Editor freezes if MSI Afterburner is closed while a project is being opened with D3D12 render device
body:
### Tested versions

only tested in some version(random picked)
4.2.2 stable:crash
4.5.2 stable:normal with warn
```
Godot Engine v4.5.stable.official.876b29033 - https://godotengine.org
D3D12 12_0 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU
WARNING: PSO caching is not implemented yet in the Direct3D 12 driver.
     at: pipeline_cache_create (drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:4255)
```
4.6 dev6 to current stable version(4.7.2):freeze with many log:
```
ERROR: Condition "!((HRESULT)(res) >= 0)" is true. Returning: ERR_UNAVAILABLE
   at: swap_chain_resize (drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:2799)
ERROR: Condition "!((HRESULT)(res) >= 0)" is true. Returning: ERR_UNAVAILABLE
   at: swap_chain_resize (drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:2799)
ERROR: Condition "!((HRESULT)(res) >= 0)" is true. Returning: ERR_UNAVAILABLE
   at: swap_chain_resize (drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:2799)
...
```

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1074) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11800H @ 2.30GHz (16 threads) - 31.51 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

current behaviour after run with Steps to reproduce: freeze with logs:
```
ERROR: Condition "!((HRESULT)(res) >= 0)" is true. Returning: ERR_UNAVAILABLE
   at: swap_chain_resize (drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:2799)
ERROR: Condition "!((HRESULT)(res) >= 0)" is true. Returning: ERR_UNAVAILABLE
   at: swap_chain_resize (drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:2799)
ERROR: Condition "!((HRESULT)(res) >= 0)" is true. Returning: ERR_UNAVAILABLE
   at: swap_chain_resize (drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:2799)
...
```
target behaviour:normal to load project

### Steps to reproduce

1.start MSIAfterburner
2.start editor start page
3.enter a project with D3D12 render device
4.shutdown MSIAfterburner while it loading
5.freezed

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

no script no shader

[bug_test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33296276/bug_test.zip)
